description: This file defines the MessagePackCodec class, which implements serialization, copying, and type filtering functionalities using MessagePack within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for serializing/deserializing objects, copying objects, and determining supported types, with references to external MessagePack and Orleans serialization components.

classes.name: MessagePackCodec
classes.description: A serialization codec that uses MessagePackSerializer for serialization, copying, and type filtering within Orleans.

methods.name: MessagePackCodec
methods.description: Constructor initializing the codec with type selectors and options.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field value into the writer, including type information and object data.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value from the reader, reconstructing the object based on type information.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Determines if a type is supported for serialization or copying.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object using MessagePack serialization.

methods.name: IsTypeAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a type is allowed based on support for serialization or copying.

methods.name: IsMessagePackContract
methods.description: Checks if a type is a MessagePack contract, considering attributes.

methods.name: ThrowTypeFieldMissing
methods.description: Throws an exception if a serialized value is missing its type field.
